title: Role of the NO-sGC-cGMP axis in vasopressor dependent sepsis
summary: Sepsis occurs when an already-present infection begins to cause organ damage, and even death. Sepsis may be accompanied by a very low blood pressure and impairment of blood supply to the organs. This low blood pressure is caused by an impaired pathway called the NO-sGC-cGMP-pathway. There are drugs available to affect this pathway. However, we do not know enough about the time course of this pathway during sepsis to allow drug therapy. We also do not know, how lab values indicate changes in this pathway.  This study was designed to increase our knowledge of the NO-sGC-cGMP-pathway by analyzing blood samples from patients with sepsis.

interventions.name: Patients who had been included in the SISPCT-trial are eligible for this study. A random sample is drawn from the original SISPCT study population for further analysis.
